summary: PROVISIONAL ENTRY. Root plḥ is a literal filing of the printed pləḥle, not an established root identification. There is one occurrence, no securely attested Infectum, and no evidence for any other stem or sense.
The overt zero-marked ʕaršona 'her teeth' follows pləḥle after an explicit blow to her mouth. This supports teeth-breaking; it does not decide whether teeth were fractured or knocked out.

Lookup verifies plx II mpalaxle/mpaləx 'zertrümmern, in Stücke schlagen' and flḥ I fləḥle/foləḥ '(durch)ackern'. The former differs in final consonant and stem, the latter in initial consonant and meaning. Neither is silently substituted for plḥ.
No etymology is assigned from the comparison entries, and no hypothetical Infinitiv or Infectum is presented as attested.
